SO-101 Robot Arm (SmolVLA)

Built a SO-101 robot arm with custom 3D-printed parts and motors, then trained a SmolVLA policy from 250+ demonstrations to reach 95% autonomous pick-and-place success.

Autonomous Competition Robot (QKRT)

Autonomous sentry robot for the ARC competition with a ROS 2 navigation stack fusing camera, LiDAR, IMU, and wheel encoder data, validated in Gazebo with SLAM, planning, and obstacle avoidance.

ROS 2SLAMNavigationSensor FusionGazebo
Knee-Impairment RL Gait Policy

This project is a small, targeted modification to NVIDIA Isaac Lab’s Unitree H1 locomotion task to simulate a gait impairment via reduced knee flexion range-of-motion (ROM) and train a policy that can still walk stably under that constraint using PPO

Diffusion-Based 6-DoF Pick-and-Place Robot

A diffusion-based robotic manipulation system that uses a U-Net policy to generate smooth 6-DoF pick-and-place actions. Built on Google’s Ravens framework, the model learns from expert demonstrations to perform precise grasping and placement through iterative denoising and trajectory sampling.

PythonPyTorchDiffusion ModelsU-NetRavens Framework6-DoF Robot Arm
Imitation Learning for Walking Robots (Behavioral Cloning & DAgger, MuJoCo)

Two MuJoCo walking agents, Ant and 2D Walker, were trained to perform locomotion using both Behavioural Cloning and DAgger cloning using provided expert policies.

PythonImitation LearningDeep LearningMuJoCo sim
Autonomous SLAM Robot with LiDAR and 2-Wheel Drive

A custom-built autonomous robot that uses SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) and LiDAR to navigate and map its environment. The robot is a 2-wheel differential drive system running on ROS 2, with real-time mapping and basic autonomous navigation functionality.

ROS 2Arduino NanoRaspberry Pi 53D PrintingGazebo
Blackjack Bot using Deep Q-Learning

This project implements both Q-learning and Deep Q-Learning (DQN) algorithms to train agents to play Blackjack using environments from Gymnasium (OpenAI's Gym fork). The goal is to develop an agent that can beat the house and consistently win games using reinforcement learning.

PyTorchPythonNeural NetworksOpenAI GymDeep LearningQ-Learning
3-DOF Robotic Arm (Arduino, ROS2, MoveIt)

This project is a 3-DOF manipulator using Arduino for servo actuation and hardware control. It uses ROS2 MoveIt teleoperation for kinematics and trajectory planning both in simulation and real-world.

ROS 2MoveItArduinoPython3D Printing
Smart Door Intercom

A smart door intercom that uses a Pi Camera to capture visitor photos and send them to Telegram for remote approval. Linked an Arduino via serial so user replies directly actuated a servo motor to unlock the door.

Four-Leaf Clover Classifier (ResNet18 + PyTorch)

This project is a deep learning image classifier designed to distinguish between 3-leaf and 4-leaf white clovers using a self-collected dataset and a ResNet18 architecture. It demonstrates how data augmentation and transfer learning can be used to train models on small, real-world datasets.

PyTorchOpenCVPythonCNNsMachine Learning
Cracked Concrete Classifier (ResNet18 + PyTorch)

This project is a deep learning model that classifies cracked and uncracked concrete images using a ResNet-based architecture. It leverages an open dataset to achieve high classification accuracy.

Machine LearningPyTorchPythonNeural Networks
Rainfall Prediction using Machine Learning

This project predicts rainfall using machine learning models trained on weather data from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology. The pipeline includes preprocessing, feature selection, and model training.
